caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bed with rounded, scroll-like head and footboards, rendered in shades of brown to represent wood grain. The bed has tall, thick legs and decorative paneling on its frame. The headboard is higher than the footboard, and both ends curve outward at the top. The side rails and central panel have a wave-like design. To the left of the main colored illustration, there is a black-and-white technical drawing showing a section and outside elevation view of the bed’s structure. Below the illustration, measurements are listed: length 6 feet 10 1/2 inches, width 4 feet 10 1/2 inches, height 3 feet 1 3/8 inches at the head end, and 2 feet 11 3/8 inches at the foot end. The scale for the section and elevation is 1 1/2 inches to 1 foot. The drawing is signed at the bottom left. The background is a plain, light tan color.
title: Sleigh Bed
